name: Watchog
description: Watchog, the Lookout Pokémon, and the evolved form of Patrat. A Normal type.
pokedex_entries: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.
They make the patterns on their bodies shine in order to threaten predators. Keen eyesight lets them see in the dark.
Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.
